method: InFoBench-inspired decomposed requirement evaluation; not official InFoBench benchmark scores
selection: The three existing customization pairs, including their original base reports, selected for structure/style/depth coverage, not scores.
execution: One fresh context per report; all decomposed questions in that report scored together. Report and source text are untrusted data. No prior judgments supplied.
adaptations: Local financial report tasks instead of official 500 prompts
Report-level batch instead of upstream sequential question conversation
JSON labels, verbatim quotes and short reasons
UNKNOWN retained instead of forced binary choice
Source excerpts supplied for evidence-dependent requirements
Mechanical rules scored by code separately
Semantic depth is an exploratory operationalization, excluded from instruction-following aggregate
aggregation: Semantic following lower bound = YES / all planned explicit semantic requirements; upper bound = (YES + UNKNOWN + invalid/missing) / all planned explicit semantic requirements. Both micro and equal-report macro averages; no independent-observation inference. Mechanical compliance separate. Depth diagnostic separate.
checks: Repeat the three customized reports once, independently. On the same three customized reports remove all body content, retaining headings and Sources: content criteria should fail. These deliberately easy negative controls check gross failure only, not evaluator validity.
limits: Post-hoc exploratory analysis of previously generated reports
Same model deployment name as generator, with unpinned current weights; self-preference and shared errors possible
Only six reports from three tasks; no statistical superiority claim
No direct-generation baseline in this evaluator feasibility pilot
No citation entailment precision/recall or exhaustive factual accuracy claim
mutation_policy: Original reports, historical reviews and manuscript results remain immutable; all new outputs in a separate session. Any transport/parse/quote failure remains recorded, without silent retry.
